title: Load repair parameters into the work order object
goal: Returns multiple named fields using object literals, preserving the type of the input values.
summary: repair reporting system hands the problem, estimated time and emergency status to the maintenance personnel. Collect separate parameters into the same work order object.
tasks: complete makeRepairOrder(issue, minutes, urgent). Return an object with field names issue, minutes, and urgent.
Fill in the corresponding value according to the parameter with the same name. issue holds a string, minutes holds a number, and urgent holds a boolean.

example.note: The left side of the colon is the field name, and the right side is filled with the parameter value. When the field and value variables have the same name, they can be abbreviated as {holder, confirmed}.

hint: Just save urgent into the object directly. Wrapping field values ​​in quotes or converting to literals will lose the Boolean type.
